title: Catalog provenance & perf-publish playbook for community-contributed model onboarding
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a hardened playbook and lightweight automation for ingesting community-contributed models (OSS checkpoints and vendor-supplied artifacts) into the Redwood model catalog. Deliverables: (1) mandatory provenance metadata fields and schema extension for community models, (2) a step-by-step perf publishing workflow (bench harness, canonical sequences, batch/seq matrix, cost/latency signatures), and (3) docs + PR checklist and examples so solutions engineers can onboard models consistently. This ticket focuses on metadata and docs; separate follow-ups will add end-to-end automation (lint hooks, ingest pipelines).
acceptance_criteria: Schema extended with provenance fields: source_uri, upstream_repo_commit, license_expression, artifact_hashes, tokenizer_fingerprint, sample_prompts_used
Published perf profile template and example for at least two community models (one 7B-class, one 13B-class) in the catalog UI and docs
Onboarding PR checklist added to Confluence and linked from the catalog ingestion flow
Playbook includes guidance for pinning policy, variant compatibility mapping, and recommended quantization tags
Security/Legal sign-off flow documented (when license_expression is restrictive) and requirement flag set on model entries
Manual runbook validated by SE team during two dry-run onboards and feedback items tracked as follow-ups
tasks: Draft schema extension proposal for catalog metadata (include example JSON and validation rules)
Define canonical perf harness configuration: sequence lengths, request shapes, batching matrix, and JIT/kernel notes
Create a sample perf run notebook and CI script that produces the perf profile artifact (latency P50/P95, throughput, cost estimate per 1k tokens)
Author Confluence playbook with step-by-step onboarding checklist and PR template
Add model-entry flags for 'community_provenance_reviewed' and 'license_blocker' to catalog UI schema
Coordinate 2 dry-run onboards with SE and Legal and capture feedback
Publish docs page and add cross-links from the console onboarding flow
